name: load-earlier
title: Load earlier
description: Load earlier messages at the top of a feed without the scroll jumping: it keeps your place when older items arrive.
docs: Put it first in the scrolling list, above the items, and pass hasEarlier, loading, error and onLoadEarlier. When the older items are added above, the row keeps the reader on the item they were looking at: it measures that item before and after and corrects the scroll position by the difference, so it works where the browser does not anchor the scroll and does not correct twice where it does. Pass scrollRef when the list scrolls inside a box (otherwise the nearest scrolling ancestor, or the page, is used). Set auto to load when the row scrolls into view; the button stays as the fallback. Pass count and noun to have what arrived announced once as a count (12 earlier messages loaded). Keep the list itself out of a live region, or every old message would be read out. The row has four states: the button, a spinner row, an error with Retry, and a quiet start of the conversation.
